description: L3 spatial: UV repetition. Requires fract/modulo reasoning.
prompt: Write a GLSL ES 3.0 fragment shader in shader.glsl implementing mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord). iResolution (vec3) and iTime (float) are provided; do not redeclare them and do not write main(). Requirements: (1) draw a checkerboard that repeats EXACTLY 8 times across the width and 8 times down the height; (2) squares must alternate between near-black and a bright green, with hard edges and no blur; (3) the pattern must not change with iTime; (4) no NaN output.
